title: The Vedic Age: From Pastoral Tribes to Kingdoms

questions.question: Which Veda is essentially a book of melodies and is regarded as the root of Indian music?
questions.rationale: The Samaveda sets Rigvedic verses to saman (melodies) for the Udgatri priest to sing — the origin of Indian musical tradition.

questions.question: The Battle of Ten Kings (Dasarajna) was fought on the banks of which river?
questions.rationale: Sudas of the Bharatas defeated a ten-tribe confederacy on the Parushni, identified with the modern Ravi, in the great Rigvedic conflict.

questions.question: The Rigvedic word 'gavishti', used for war, literally means:
questions.rationale: Gavishti literally means 'search for cows' — in a pastoral economy where cattle were the core of wealth, war was about herds.

questions.question: In Early Vedic polity, which body was the wider assembly that chose and advised the rajan?
questions.rationale: The samiti was the broader assembly that selected and advised the tribal chief, while the sabha was the council of elders; the vidatha was older still and admitted women.

questions.question: Iron, known to Later Vedic people as 'krishna ayas', appears in the archaeological record of the doab from about:
questions.rationale: Iron (krishna ayas) appears from about 1000 BCE at sites such as Atranjikhera, alongside Painted Grey Ware, marking the Later Vedic eastward expansion.

questions.question: The Purusha Sukta, which gives the mythic origin of the four varnas, is found in:
questions.rationale: The Purusha Sukta (Rigveda 10.90) describes the four varnas emerging from the sacrificed cosmic man — the ideological seed of the varna order.

questions.question: Which of these was a grand royal ritual of the Later Vedic age in which a horse roamed free for a year?
questions.rationale: In the ashvamedha a royal stallion roamed for a year under escort; lands it crossed had to accept the king's supremacy or fight.

questions.question: The famous philosophical debates of King Janaka's court took place in the kingdom of:
questions.rationale: Janaka of Videha hosted Yajnavalkya and the women debaters Gargi and Maitreyi — debates that fed directly into the Upanishads.

questions.question: India's national motto 'Satyameva Jayate' is taken from which text?
questions.rationale: 'Satyameva Jayate' — truth alone triumphs — comes from the Mundaka Upanishad, part of the 108 texts in the traditional Muktika list.

questions.question: How many Vedangas are there, and what do they collectively do?
options: Six, auxiliary disciplines for studying the Veda
questions.rationale: The six Vedangas — Shiksha, Kalpa, Vyakarana, Nirukta, Chhanda, Jyotisha — are the 'limbs' that help preserve and study the Veda.
